description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys IPC callback handling in the Rialto client, including tests for license request, license renewal, and key status change events, with mock expectations and event creation helpers.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysIpcCallbackTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysIpcTestBase, providing setup and helper methods for testing MediaKeys IPC callback events.

methods.name: addPairsToKeyStatusVector
methods.description: Adds a specified number of key status pairs to the internal key status vector for testing.

methods.name: createLicenseRequestEvent
methods.description: Creates and populates a LicenseRequestEvent message with current test data.

methods.name: createKeyStatusesChangedEvent
methods.description: Creates and populates a KeyStatusesChangedEvent message with current test data.
